recall.minute: Risks: misuse, security attacks, privacy, bias/toxicity, over-reliance; agents amplify; defence in depth. Jailbreaks: role-play, false authority, obfuscation, multi-turn, many-shot, adversarial suffixes; defences: adversarial training, classifiers, monitoring, restricted capabilities. Prompt injection overrides developer instructions; indirect injection hides in web pages, emails, documents, tool outputs; mitigate by treating content as untrusted, detection, instruction hierarchy, least privilege, human confirmation. Guardrails: input classifiers, topic limits, output harm/PII filters ([EMAIL], [PHONE]), schema checks; threshold trades misses vs over-refusal. Red teaming: experts, crowds, automated attackers; ASR (60% → 0% on ex1's tiny suite, not proof of safety); regression tests. Memorisation: duplicates and size increase it; extraction and membership inference; canary exposure (19.9 bits at rank 1/1M); dedup, PII filtering, DP-SGD (clip C, Gaussian noise). Bias: data, labels, context; counterfactual tests (gap 0.87), benchmarks, toxicity rates; mitigate with data, augmentation, alignment, filters, human accountability.
